**Why this is harmful:**

If an unexpected expense—like a medical bill, car repair, or job loss—occurs, you may be forced to dip into your investment or savings accounts at the worst possible time, which can derail your progress and even result in financial loss.

**Why it matters:**  
Without an emergency fund, you might end up taking on high-interest debt or withdrawing from investments at a loss during downturns, undoing all the gains you worked hard to build.

---

**Why this is harmful:**
